name: aura
description: AURA project scaffolding and agent management
whenToInvoke: Starting new AURA project or creating agent definitions. AURA is the north star: agentic software development.
workflow:
1. Scaffold AURA monorepo structure
2. Create agent definitions (planner, executor, reviewer, researcher)
3. Set up evals/ harness/ memory/ skills/ config/
4. Initialize learning layer for AURA project
5. Run 'mia aura init' in target directory

constitutionalAlignment.reasoning: AURA is the north star project. Agent architecture follows constitutional principles: single responsibility, clear triggers, composable workflows, progressive disclosure, portable content. Primary value: Helpful (enables agentic software development).
